title: fair-publishing
description: Publishes datasets and models from a Flask application to a research repository (Zenodo in v1) under the user's own account, with DataCite metadata, RO-Crate, a dataset or model card, legal fields and label provenance, after an attestation of license, rights and personal data. Mounts in-process with init_publishing(app, ...) and receives artefacts from the host through a provider protocol.
